title: Changelog - December 2024
text:
## Changelog - December 2024
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102976
New Features:
We created a new Design Setting called "Only Display 'Verified' Members?" When enabling this new setting the Recent Members homepage widget will only display "Verified" members. We also added the "Display Verified Badge" Design Setting to control whether or not the verified badge displays for members in the homepage widget.
We added the ability to upload .json, .csv and .tsv files using the Media Manager page in the Admin.
We updated the decline lead modal to allow members to provide feedback as to why they are declining a lead.  This information will then display on the Match Leads page in the Admin.
We added a new API Endpoint to the Brilliant Directories API which allows fetching information about a member's transactions via user_id.
We created a new Membership Plan Setting called "Logged In Member Main Menu". This setting allows Admins to choose a different Main Menu to display for each Membership Plan when a member is logged in on the website.
Enhancements / Fixes:
We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the Import Business Data tool in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Get Directions" button on the Post Location Map widget from working properly in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from using the Export Posts functionality in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Stock Photo Library from working properly after performing a search in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the %subscription_name% email variable from working properly when composing individual emails in the Admin.
We updated the Text Labels module to add support for several additional languages.
We updated the content of the subscription downgrade email template.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to delete member categories from the Member Categories page in the Admin in some cases.
We updated the "Website "FROM" Email Address" General Setting to support the ".com.jm" Top Level Domain extension.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the member search results page from returning accurate results after performing a location search in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to incorrectly include manually geocoded members in the list of members missing location information on the Geocode Members page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue with the Search Members page in the Admin which was preventing the system from returning accurate results when performing a location search in some cases.
We fixed an issue with the "Website - Lead - Get Matched" form which was preventing the "Make Location Fields Required?" Lead Setting from working properly when the "Map Display Options" Lead Setting was set to "Only Input" in some cases.
W e removed the Size, Image Caption and Alt Text options from the image toolbar options on the Private Chat Message Froala Editor.
W e updated the Title and Help Text for new triggers on the Brilliant Directories Zapier App.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Event Search results from returning accurate results after searching for a specific date range in some cases.
We fixed an issue with the Private Member Chat Add-On which was preventing the system from sending the chat email notifications in some cases.
We updated the Brilliant Directories API to add the ability to search by members.
We updated the Upgrade Summary module on the Member Dashboard to improve its display on mobile devices.
The Private Member Chat Add-On is now compatible with the Time and Date Format Settings.
W e updated the Web Page Builder to support selecting the "Custom Widget as Web Page" option as the Page Type setting when editing Homepage in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Products and Classifieds Homepage widgets from displaying the post price in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Membership Plans page in the Admin from displaying the "Move Members" action link.
We fixed an issue that was causing the system to display duplicate results on Post Search Results pages when the "Order Results By" Post Setting was set to "Random" and the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On was active.
We fixed an issue that was affecting the ability to delete Posts via bulk action from the Admin in some cases.
W e fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to schedule Smart Lists to be sent to a webhook endpoint in the Admin.
W e updated the Activity Tracker to log the previous and new value of the changed items when an Admin updates a Post Setting.
W e fixed an issue which was preventing the Brilliant Directories Zapier App from working properly when trying to update and remove Member Tags in some cases.
W e updated the Text Labels module to add support for several additional languages.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from refunding member credits to members after attempting to purchase a lead that was "Sold Out" in some cases.
W e fixed an issue that was preventing the "Auto Import the post images based on 'Post Image' during import" Import Post Setting from working properly in some cases.
W e fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to customize and save Forms when the 2FA logic is enabled and the website is not using an SSL certificate.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the Canonical URL from working properly when the "Default Member Search URL" was updated and the site was not using an SSL certificate in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Category dropdowns on the Get Matched form from working properly when the "Pre-Selected Top Level Category" Lead Setting was active in some cases.
W e updated the modal workflow when deleting Members on the Search Members page in the Admin.
W e fixed an issue that was causing the system to display the "Activate Add-Ons" button on the Business Data page in the Admin when the Add-On is already activate on the site in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from correctly encoding the member location URLs when importing members using the Business Data Tool.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the field mapping logic from working properly when importing members via CSV file in some cases.
W e implemented a security update to the member post creation logic in the Member Dashboard.
We implemented a security update to the Add New Member modal on the Search Members page in the Admin.
We updated the member location field validation on the Contact Details form in the Member Dashboard to revalidate the required fields after selecting a new location from the Google Maps search field.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to return a 404 error when the URL of a static web page ended with "/" in some cases.
We updated the "Delete Unused Image" tool in the Admin Dashboard to run more quickly and only require a single pass through the images on the site rather than multiple passes.
W e updated the display of the About Me form data on member profile pages in order to respect the order and display setting of the fields.
W e added the ability to sort by "My Saved Templates" when searching for Email Templates on the Email Templates page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to upload ".pptx" file using the Media Manager in the Admin in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Post Limit Reached Modal after updating the status of a post from "Unpublished" to "Published" in the Member Dashboard area.
W e fixed an issue which was preventing the " Sort By" setting for the " Recent Sub-Level Categories" homepage section from working properly in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Click here to return to the homepage" link from working properly when the "You cannot submit a review for your own profile" Advanced Setting was active in some cases.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the "Required" logic from working properly for the "Start Date" field when both "Start Date" and "End Date" are set to be required on the "Feature - Events" Form in some cases.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the system from correctly encoding URLs in some cases.
We improved the error handling of the File Upload form field to provide more informative messages when a file cannot be uploaded.
We implemented a security update to the Search Members page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue that was causing the system to display expired posts on post search result pages in some cases.
We updated the layout of the "My Imports" tab on the Business Data page to enable exporting the member data for each individual import.
We updated the Stock Photo Library Add-On when uploading cover photo images to hide the orientation field and remove the alt attribute on the cover photo image.
W e added the ability to select multiple forms when using the "Filter Forms" field on the Forms Inbox page in the Admin.
In all, over 70 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
